from pathlib import Path
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mb_ereg_variation3.phpt","function":"<global>","line":14,"var":"mb_regex_encoding","code":"mb_regex_encoding('utf-8');","note":"The regex engine is configured for UTF-8, so multibyte character-class patterns are decoded through the Oniguruma UTF-8 path."},
{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mb_ereg_variation3.phpt","function":"<global>","line":15,"var":"pattern","code":"$character_classes = array(... '[[:alnum:]]+' ...);","note":"Character-class patterns are accepted as attacker-controlled regex input and compiled by mbstring."},
{"step":3,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mb_ereg_variation3.phpt","function":"<global>","line":31,"var":"mb_ereg","code":"var_dump(mb_ereg($pattern, $string, $regs));","note":"mb_ereg forwards the supplied pattern into the shared mbregex compilation and execution machinery."},
{"step":4,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg)","line":0,"var":"pattern","code":"mb_ereg forwards the supplied pattern into php_mbregex_compile_pattern and Oniguruma","note":"The attacker-controlled regex pattern reaches Oniguruma's parser and optimizer via mbstring."},
{"step":5,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_exec","line":900,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"re = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, options, MBREX(current_mbctype), MBREX(regex_default_syntax));","note":"Compilation is the key entry point where the vulnerable AST analysis runs inside Oniguruma."},
{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"When the quantified body can match empty, Oniguruma recursively classifies the subtree for memory-node and repeat interactions."},
{"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"static enum BodyEmptyType quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"This recursive AST walk is the suspected root cause path from the crash report, matching the reported state names."},
{"step":8,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4904,"var":"NODE_CAR(node)","code":"v = quantifiers_memory_node_info(NODE_CAR(node));","note":"Nested list/alt nodes are traversed recursively, so a crafted pattern can force repeated visits through the same logical subtree."},
{"step":9,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_onig_search","line":880,"var":"err","code":"err = onig_search_with_param(reg, str, end, start, range, region, option, mp);","note":"The compiled regex is executed against the subject string; if the vulnerable compiler state is reached, the crash manifests during regex processing."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('trace updated')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/candidate_trace.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json
